description_en: Changes the resource group to which an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster belongs
description_zh: 修改集群所属的阿里云资源组
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-resource-group --db-cluster-id amv-bpxxxxx --new-resource-group-id rg-acxxxxx --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

You can use resource groups to manage resources within your Alibaba Cloud account by group. This helps you resolve issues such as resource grouping and permission management within a single Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。

资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
